verseText: And you shall love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
meaning: God commands us to love him completely, giving every part of ourselves to him.

recall.question: How should we love the LORD?
choices: With all our heart, soul, and strength

meaning.question: What does this command ask from us?

application.prompt: Choose one way today to love God with your thoughts, energy, or choices.
